claims: WrestleMania 42 was held April 18–19, 2026 in Las Vegas.
Roman Reigns defeated CM Punk in the Night 2 main event of WrestleMania 42 to win the World Heavyweight Championship.
Cody Rhodes defeated Randy Orton in the Night 1 main event of WrestleMania 42 to retain the Undisputed WWE Championship.
Rhea Ripley defeated Jade Cargill to win the WWE Women's Title at WrestleMania 42.
Liv Morgan defeated Stephanie Vaquer to win the Women's World Title at WrestleMania 42.
Oba Femi defeated Brock Lesnar at WrestleMania 42.
Penta won the Intercontinental Title ladder match at WrestleMania 42.
Trick Williams defeated Sami Zayn for the US Title at WrestleMania 42.
The Demon Finn Balor defeated Dominik Mysterio at WrestleMania 42.
LA Knight & The Usos defeated Logan Paul, Austin Theory, and IShowSpeed at WrestleMania 42
